title: Close ngcj SRD gameplay-modeling audit findings
description:
Follow-up epic from the 2026-06-29 ngcj SRD audit bundle review.

The bundle passed the normal source/reproducibility criteria:
- verify:dnd5e-srd-pack exits 0 and regenerates cleanly.
- typecheck exits 0.
- tests/check pass.
- source coverage reports unaccounted: 0.
- source-region ledger reports unrepresented: 0.
- typed class advancement, table reachability, and overlay parity pass.

The newly discovered work is not missing source coverage. It is gameplay modeling quality:
1. Some machine-readable mechanics projections are unsafe because they contain clipped regex/prose fragments.
2. Core class spell workflows are still not sufficiently structured for deterministic character creation and advancement.
3. Warlock Eldritch Invocation prerequisites are parsed incorrectly when wrapped across lines/pages.
4. Several choices still use free-text sources where deterministic tools need typed filters.
5. Subclass progression is present but not ordered/projected for easy DM/tool consumption.
6. Gameplay-readiness reporting undercounts some existing structure.
7. Non-blocking check/typecheck command-output hygiene should be cleaned up before future audit bundles.

Goal:
Make the SRD pack trustworthy for both primary DM-model discoverability and deterministic tool consumption. Machine-readable fields must be validated structure, not plausible-looking text fragments.
